bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");for(const n of ["teaching-batch-20261128-1620","teaching-parallel-20261128-1630"]){const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/app/runtime/"+n+"/status.json"));const d=s.dispatches||[];const overlap=d.some((a,i)=>d.slice(i+1).some(b=>a.model!==b.model&&a.start_ms<(b.headers_ms||Date.now())&&b.start_ms<(a.headers_ms||Date.now())));console.log(JSON.stringify({id:s.id,status:s.status,parallel_topics:s.parallel_topics,selected:s.selected,lessons:s.lessons?.map(x=>({topic:x.topic,status:x.status,phase:x.phase,verdict:x.verdict,error:x.error})),cost_usd:s.cost_usd,dispatch_count:d.length,overlap,updated_at:s.updated_at,error:s.error}));}'
